sources.note: Main site. Describes Qualifacts as behavioral health EHR company with 4 platforms (Credible, CareLogic, InSync, OnCall). Claims 2,700+ agencies across 50 states, 1/3 of CCBHC agencies.
ONC certification disclosures page. Lists four certified products: CareLogic, Credible, InSync, OnCall. Links to Real-World Testing plans/results. No pricing or detailed product descriptions.

Credible platform page. Describes key features: configurable documentation, assessments (CANS, ASAM, PHQ-9, Wiley), integrated billing with 8% fewer denials claim, mobile app, residential/inpatient management, 60+ alert types, BI dashboards.

Feature overview page. Lists clinical management, scheduling, billing, RCM, credentialing, client portal, telehealth, measurement-based care, AI clinical documentation (Qualifacts iQ), analytics/reporting.
IT solutions page. Describes self-service admin configuration, SSL encryption, MFA, IP whitelisting, SSO, SOC2 compliance, auto-save/draft recovery, HIPAA compliance.

August 2020 merger announcement. Qualifacts (CareLogic) merged with Credible Behavioral Health (founded 2000). Backed by Warburg Pincus and Martis Capital. Combined entity serves 800+ agencies at time of merger.
Software Advice profile for Credible. 403 on direct fetch but search results showed features: scheduling, treatment planning, documentation, ePrescribing, billing, telehealth, patient portal.
GetApp profile. 403 on direct fetch but search results described features and reviews. Users praise reporting capabilities, intuitive interface. Some concerns about system speed and outages.
October 2023 press release. Qualifacts claims 170+ CCBHC customers, leading market position in behavioral health EHR.
July 2023 press release. Nine California counties selected Qualifacts for behavioral health EHR, demonstrating county-level government contracts.
Integration marketplace. Could not fetch directly (ECONNREFUSED), but vendor materials reference 80+ integrations including labs, pharmacies, HIEs, ACOs, and the OneQ integration layer.
Great Hill Partners majority investment announcement (July 2014). Describes Qualifacts as largest SaaS behavioral health EHR provider.
November 2022 acquisition of OnCall Health (Canadian telehealth/patient portal company) by Qualifacts.
